newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish March North Sea gas production up 10.3 pct.
newsitem.headline: Danish March North Sea gas production up 10.3 pct.

text.p: Danish Underground Consortium (DUC) production of gas from its North Sea fields rose 10.3 percent in March 1997 to 695 million cubic metres from 630 million cubic metres in February, a spokesman for operator A.P. Moeller Group told Reuters on Monday.

DUC is responsible for virtually the entire output from Denmark's North Sea oil and gas fields which make the country the fourth-biggest offshore gas producer in western Europe after Norway, Britain and the Netherlands.
A.P. Moeller Group owns 39 percent of DUC. Its two partners, Royal Dutch/Shell group and Texaco Inc own 46 percent and 15 percent respectively.
